newsitem.title: USA: Church & Dwight sees yr earnings improvement.
newsitem.headline: Church & Dwight sees yr earnings improvement.

text.p: Church & Dwight Co Inc said Thursday that it should see solid improvement in earnings for the year.
The company reported that third quarter net income rose to $5.2 million or $0.27 per share, compared to $1.6 million or $0.08 per share a year ago.
It attributed the figures to sales of household and personal care products that were well ahead of last year's sales, particularly with the relaunching of Arm & Hammer product lines.
"The positive trend continues in the fourth quarter, and we believe the company is on track for a solid improvement in earnings for the year," it stated.
